name: @supacloud/js
description: Platform SDK for SupaCloud, built on top of supabase-js

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.build:js: bun run build:js:esm && bun run build:js:cjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run check:package
scripts.build:js:esm: bun build src/index.ts src/task-events.ts --outdir dist --format esm --entry-naming "[name].mjs" --chunk-naming "[name]-[hash].mjs" --target node --external @supabase/supabase-js --external @supacloud/contracts && bun build src/contracts.ts src/query.ts --outdir dist --format esm --entry-naming "[name].mjs" --chunk-naming "[name]-[hash].mjs" --target browser --external @supacloud/contracts --external @tanstack/query-core && bun build src/reactive.ts --outdir dist --format esm --entry-naming "[name].mjs" --chunk-naming "[name]-[hash].mjs" --target browser --external rxjs
scripts.build:js:cjs: bun build src/index.ts src/task-events.ts --outdir dist --format cjs --entry-naming "[name].cjs" --chunk-naming "[name]-[hash].cjs" --target node --external @supabase/supabase-js --external @supacloud/contracts && bun build src/contracts.ts src/query.ts --outdir dist --format cjs --entry-naming "[name].cjs" --chunk-naming "[name]-[hash].cjs" --target browser --external @supacloud/contracts --external @tanstack/query-core && bun build src/reactive.ts --outdir dist --format cjs --entry-naming "[name].cjs" --chunk-naming "[name]-[hash].cjs" --target browser --external rxjs
